item.text:
Refactored the engine layer again so responsibilities are more clearly separated.

[QuickSelectEngine.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/041_quickselect/QuickSelectEngine.java:1) now just coordinates the selection loop. The partition mechanics moved into [Partitioner.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/041_quickselect/Partitioner.java:1), and the mutable search window moved into [SearchBounds.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/041_quickselect/SearchBounds.java:1). That leaves each class with one narrow concern: facade, request prep, engine loop, partitioning, pivot policy, and bounds tracking.

Verified with `javac QuickSelect.java QuickSelectEngine.java SelectionRequest.java PivotSelector.java MedianOfThreePivotSelector.java Partitioner.java SearchBounds.java QuickSelectDemo.java`, `java QuickSelect`, and `java QuickSelectDemo`. Both entrypoints still print `K-th smallest element in array: 6`.
